scope: Independent static oracle review only: bindings_and_observation, adversarial_actual_batch, actual_relocation_keeps_content_bindings_and_refuses_old_physical_scope and direct consumers. No new executable evidence observed in this review.
positive_static_observations: Logical input/capture/snapshot expected descriptors are independently reconstructed from frozen DEV fixture path inventory, exact request source text and supplied SDK. No producer batch::input_manifest/capture_manifest/snapshot_manifest helper is called for expected descriptors.

Input and capture use logical v2 domains; snapshot uses T00-captured-snapshot-v2 and independently computed input/capture digests. Source bytes, SDK version/archive/content and case sensitivity remain represented.

Postcapture mutation writes and rereads a real DEV file, reconstructs changed logical descriptors, explicitly checks input/capture/snapshot differ while scope is equal, and requires both old expected/current mismatch and new expected/stale output mismatch to reject.

Actual relocation executes the native batch again under a distinct physical repository root and SDK root; asserts frozen semantics and joins reported reads to exact supplied bytes before receive. Logical descriptors and actual batch input/capture/snapshot/producer IDs remain equal while physical scope IDs differ.

Relocation negative controls include old receiver versus relocated actual batch/current and scope-only current mutation for both receive and receipt revalidation. These isolate physical scope from content identity.
The oracle explicitly limits relocation to DEV producer executions, preserves graph physical metadata as potentially variable, and denies graph relocation invariance and T02 acquisition claims.
Poisoned stdout is labeled an in-memory transport adversary, not an observed subprocess outcome; owned supervision evidence is preserved separately.
limits: No Cargo/test command run by this reviewer; final debug/release execution must bind this exact test source and integrated producer.
No native Windows or Linux execution reviewed.

Helper supports only these simple DEV fixtures: text representation only; canonical relative fixture names; SDK entries directly below the selected SDK directory. It asserts and refuses broader input shapes rather than silently guessing.

Observed facts and graph carrier are derived from actual batch and admitted only after assert_semantics checks the separate frozen semantic oracle. This binds carrier identity but does not independently certify every possible fact or arbitrary capture protocol.
No full T02, atomic snapshot, fresh live acquisition, arbitrary-byte filesystem completeness, reserved-corpus qualification, R0 or READY_TS_NATIVE claim is supported by this static review.
